title: Implement bearer token authentication for admin endpoint
description:
Add optional bearer token authentication to the admin HTTP endpoint. Token configured as a string in [admin] config section. If token is set, all requests must include `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header; missing or wrong token → 401. If token is not set, endpoint is unauthenticated (development mode, warned at startup). Artifact: transit/src/admin.rs and reader/src/admin.rs updated.

Acceptance: correct token → 200; wrong token → 401; missing token → 401; no token configured → 200 with startup warning in logs; unit test for each case
